verdict.rationale: Deepgram Voice Agent is itself a documented public API: a single WebSocket endpoint at /v1/agent/converse, with documented control messages such as InjectAgentMessage and a Console API for reusable agent configurations. A live probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec (openapi.json returns HTTP 200), and the docs include multi-language quickstarts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Deepgram's Voice Agent API collapses that stack into a single, unified API. You open one WebSocket connection, send audio in, and receive audio out.
The Voice Agent API is available on the EU endpoint at wss://api.eu.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse
Store a reusable agent block using the Console API and receive a unique UUID
